rationale_evidence.statement: Presents both physical options and recommends the lowest-risk starting point for the Golden Trace, arguing clean bounded-context boundaries let a Governance Module->Integration Event->Assurance Module later become Governance Service->Message Broker->Assurance Service without changing the semantic architecture.
